column1: # Tier-3 harness artifact map — the single binding between a committed artifact
# and the source, compiler output path, build script, and publish group behind it.
# Read by `harness-artifacts.py`, which drives build staging, publish selection,
# the source hashes in `artifacts/manifest.json`, and the compile-vs-use check in
# `verify-tier3-artifacts.sh`. Add a harness here once and every consumer sees it.
#   artifact         path under both OUT_DIR and the tracked artifacts/ tree
#   source           git-tracked .sol the artifact is compiled from
#   compiler_output  path the compiler emits the artifact at, under its raw out dir
#   build_script     script that produces the artifact (invoked once per unique value)
